decisions.reason: Conditional help during the client-operated KDP process does not change the required back matter or author biography content.
The source adds conditional KDP workflow support but does not change the existing guidance goal or publication-prerequisite topics.
Conditional KDP support does not resolve or modify the cover design, trim size, or choice between retaining and replacing the cover.
The offer of help if the client becomes blocked does not alter the copyright-page publication attribution.
KDP workflow assistance does not change the manuscript copyediting or proofreading requirements.
Conditional publishing-process support does not change the paperback format or 6 x 9 inch trim size.
The source does not modify any required manuscript passage, tracked edit, or final-content integrity constraint.
Assistance when blocked in the KDP process does not change Chapter 18 typography or heading-consistency requirements.
The source does not change image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
Conditional KDP support does not alter chapter-image coverage, placement, reference method, or full-page presentation.
The source does not change the permitted image source, suitability review, or selection criteria.
